about_the_game:
Lightrix is a sleek, minimalist puzzle game about blending colored lights to match target hues across a glowing matrix of cubes. Using intuitive logic and a clean interface, players manipulate light to complete each level.

The full game includes 30 handcrafted puzzles that gradually introduce new complexities, alongside an endless mode designed for relaxed, meditative play—perfect for unwinding like a game of sudoku with a futuristic twist.

With sharp visual design, responsive controls, and both day and night modes for aesthetic flexibility, Lightrix offers a focused and satisfying single-player experience that’s as stylish as it is smart.

Features:

  • 30 unique handcrafted puzzle levels

  • Endless mode for infinite, casual challenges

  • Sleek, sci-fi-inspired visuals with dynamic lighting

  • Day/Night visual modes for personal preference

  • Intuitive color-mixing mechanics

  • Relaxing, logic-based gameplay perfect for short bursts or long sessions
